journey.title: Press the down arrow on a tab without being switched to another tab
journey.goal: The down arrow leaves the Past day tab selected and its panel shown, as only left and right arrows move between horizontal tabs

guards.title: Move to the next tab with the right arrow
guards.goal: The right arrow selects and focuses Past week

plan.root_cause: The GOVUK Tabs component interprets ArrowDown as a request to move to the next tab, causing focus and selection to shift from the Past day tab to the Past week tab when the down arrow is pressed.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a global keydown listener that prevents the default action for ArrowDown and ArrowUp keys when the event target is a tab (.govuk-tabs__tab), preserving horizontal tab navigation via left/right arrows only.

edits.after:
<script type="module">
import { Tabs } from './packages/govuk-frontend/src/govuk/components/tabs/tabs.js'
new Tabs(document.getElementById('applications-tabs'))
</script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.target.matches('.govuk-tabs__tab') && (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp')) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing the Down or Up arrow keys while focused on a tab will no longer change the selected tab or panel, allowing users to scroll the page or interact with tab panel content without unintended navigation.
functional_risks: If any custom functionality legitimately relied on ArrowDown/ArrowUp within tabs, it will be blocked.
Screen readers that use arrow keys for internal navigation may experience altered behavior, though ARIA authoring practices advise against using arrow keys for tablist navigation horizontally.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing ArrowDown on a tab does not change the selected tab attribute or panel visibility.
Verify that pressing ArrowLeft and ArrowRight still correctly move focus and selection between tabs.
Ensure that tab panels remain correctly shown/hidden according to the selected tab after arrow key interactions.
Confirm that other page controls (links, buttons, form fields) retain normal keyboard operation.

plan.root_cause: The GOVUK Tabs component interprets ArrowDown/ArrowUp as tab navigation keys, causing focus and selection to shift when vertical arrow keys are pressed. Since the tabs are horizontal, only Left/Right arrows should navigate.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a capture-phase keydown listener on the tabs root element that stops propagation for ArrowDown/ArrowUp when the target is a tab, preventing the component from handling these keys.

Screen readers that use arrow keys for internal navigation may experience altered behavior, though ARIA authoring practices advise against using arrow keys for tablist navigation horizontally.
